sn14.12:1.2: Sanidānam bhikkhave uppajjati kāmavitakko no anidānaṃ || sanidānam uppajjati vyāpādavitakko no anidānaṃ || sanidānam uppajjati vihiṃsāvitakko no anidānaṃ || || 3
sn14.12:2.1: Kathañca bhikkhave sanidānam uppajjati kāmavitakko no anidānaṃ || sanidānam uppajjati vyāpādavitakko no anidānaṃ || sanidānam uppajjati vihiṃsāvitakko no anidānaṃ || 4
sn14.12:2.2: Kāmadhātum bhikkhave paṭicca uppajjati kāmasaññā || kāmasaññam paṭicca uppajjati kāmasaṅkappo || kāmasaṅkappam paṭicca uppajjati kāmachando || kāmacandam paṭicca uppajjati kāmapariḷāho || kāmapariḷāham paṭicca uppajjati kāmapariyesanā ||
sn14.12:2.3: kāmapariyesanam bhikkhave pariyesamāno assutavā puthujjano tīhi ṭhānehi micchāpaṭipajjati kāyena vācāya manasā || || 5
sn14.12:3.1: Vyāpādadhātum bhikkhave paṭicca uppajati vyāpādasaññā || vyāpādasaññaṃ paṭicca uppajjati vyāpādasaṅkappo || || vyāpādachando || vyāpādapariḷāho || vyāpādapariyesanā || vyāpādapariyesanaṃ
sn14.12:3.2: bhikkhave pariyesamāno assutavā puthujjano tīhi ṭhānehi micchāpaṭipajjati kāyena vācāya manasā || || 6
sn14.12:4.1: Vihiṃsādhātum bhikkhave paṭicca uppajjati vihiṃsasaññā || pe|| || vihiṃsāsaṅkappo || vihiṃsāchando || vihiṃsāpariḷāho || vihiṃsāpariyesanā ||
sn14.12:4.2: vihiṃsāpariyesanaṃ bhikkhave pariyesamāno assutavā puthujjano tīhi ṭhānehi micchāpaṭipajjati kāyena vācāya manasā || 7
sn14.12:5.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso ādittaṃ tiṇukkaṃ sukkhe tiṇadāye nikhippeyya || no ce hatthehi ca pādehi ca khippam eva nibbāpeyya || evañhi bhikkhave ye tiṇakaṭṭhanissitā pāṇā te anayavyasanaṃ āpajjeyyuṃ || 8
sn14.12:5.2: Evam eva kho bhikkhave yo hi koci samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā uppannam visamagatam saññam na khippam eva pajahati vinodeti vyantikaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti || so diṭṭhe ceva dhamme dukkhaṃ viharati savighātam sa-upāyasam sapariḷāham ||
sn14.12:5.3: kāyassa ca bhedā param maranā duggatiṃ pāṭikaṅkhā || || 9
sn14.12:6.1: Sanidānam bhikkhave uppajjati nekkhammavitakko no anidānaṃ || sanidānaṃ uppajjati avyāpādavitakko no anidānaṃ || sanidānam uppajjati avihiṃsāvitakko no anidānaṃ || || 10
sn14.12:7.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave sanidānam uppajjati nekkhammavitakko no anidānam || sanidānam upajjati avyāpādavitakko no anidānaṃ || sanidānam uppajjati avihiṃsāvitakko no anidānaṃ || || 11
sn14.12:7.7: nekkhammapariyesanaṃ bhikkhave pariyesamāno sutavā ariyasāvako tīhi ṭhānehi sammāpaṭipajjati kāyena vācāya manasā || || 12
sn14.12:8.6: avyāpādapariyesanaṃ bhikkhave pariyesamāno sutavā ariyasāvako tīhi ṭhānehi sammāpaṭipajjati kāyena vācāya manasā || 13
sn14.12:9.6: avihiṃsāpariyesanam bhikkhave pariyesamāno sutavā ariyāsavako tīhi ṭhānehi sammāpaṭipajjati kāyena vācāya manasā || || 14
sn14.12:10.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso ādittaṃ tiṇukkaṃ sukkhe tiṇadāye nikkhipeyya || tam enaṃ hatthehi ca pādehi ca khippam eva nibbāpeyya || evaṃ hi bhikkhave ye tiṇakaṭṭhanissitā pāṇā te na anayavyasanam āpajjeyyuṃ || || 15
sn14.12:10.2: Evam eva kho bhikkhave yo hi koci samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā uppannam visamagataṃ saññaṃ khippam eva pajahati vinodeti vyantikaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti || so diṭṭhe ceva dhamme sukham viharati avighātam anupāyāsam apariḷāham ||
sn14.12:10.3: kāyassa ca bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ paṭikaṅkhāti || ||
